pages.heading: Warped Mosco
pages.body: A dangerous mutation created when a Crimson Mosquito feeds on the appropriate fungal creature. It attacks nearby prey with slams and melee

pages.heading: Warped Mosco (cont.)
pages.body: strikes, and heals by feeding. Warped Muscle and Hemolymph Sacs support the Hemolymph Blaster. Keep this experiment away from camps, livestock and travel routes.
